usage: wfdiag [-h] [--version]
              {doctor,collect,analyze,report,propose,compare} ...

Local Windows Firewall evidence diagnostics. Never applies firewall changes.

positional arguments:
  {doctor,collect,analyze,report,propose,compare}
    doctor              Check platform and evidence capabilities
    collect             Read a bounded local evidence window
    analyze             Analyze a validated case offline
    report              Export a static offline report
    propose             Export an eligible JSON review proposal
    compare             Compare completed analyses and uncertainty

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
